_invariants: Blank/non-blank strict alternation per reel (18 blank + 18 non-blank, interleaved). Position 0/2/4/... = blank; 1/3/5/... = non-blank.
Wild ONLY on reels 1+3 (outside); NEVER on reel 2. Enforces pay_id 102-104 semantics (pure-wild requires both outside reels to be wild, not center).
Boosters (mini/minor/major/grand) ONLY on reel 2 (middle); NEVER on reels 1+3.
(wild, grand, wild) on middle row is FORBIDDEN — enforced by spec.reroll_blocks + spin.py re-roll loop. Engine re-draws on this pattern.
Max payout path: (high7|wild, grand, high7|wild) = pay_id 1 × grand = 1000×. TOP tier.
_near_miss_design: Reel 2 positions 17, 19, 21 = high7, grand, high7 (with blanks at 18, 20 between them).
When reel 2 stops with grand NOT in middle row (top or bot instead), window shows high7 on the other end → 'grand was SO close to middle' emotional pull.
When reel 2 stops with grand in middle, high7 is visible in both top and bot rows via the flanking positions → payline-grand + visible-high7 creates a rich near-miss-to-1000×-via-other-reels context.
Reels 1+3 have wild directly adjacent to high7 (e.g. pos 1=wild, pos 3=high7 on reel 1) → window commonly shows both wild and high7 → supports 3-match-with-wild-sub pays (pay_id 1 with wild flank).
Reel 3 offset from reel 1 (wild/high7 positions swapped) to avoid mirror symmetry — visible across reels in different arrangements.
